description: NGI541 is a standalone, performance-oriented software cryptographic execution engine with SIMD-oriented execution paths and an independent public API. It incorporates selected cryptographic components derived from FD.io VPP native crypto, refactored and hardened through differential reference validation, SIMD-path verification, sanitizer testing, memory and buffer-geometry verification, and correction of defects identified in the inherited core code. Version 0.1.0 supports AES-CBC, AES-CTR, AES-GCM, SHA2-224, and SHA2-256.
name: NGI541
